source: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance via Earth Search STAC; NDVI -> FVC with the same NDVI_BARE/NDVI_VEG endpoints as the ward composite, albedo via the source document's §3B band coefficients.
encoding: PNG, R = vegetation fraction, G = albedo. value = ch/255 * (hi-lo) + lo
invariant: Each channel is additively shifted so its ward mean equals the measured scalar in data/dc-urs/inputs.json. The PATTERN is measured; the LEVEL is the approved DC-URS input. This is what lets the surface gain spatial detail without moving any number the score reads.
